open_points.subject: A3 INV-009 under A31 concurrency
open_points.text: a pair whose records are all revoked receives a new active record and every revoked one is unchanged; after several revoke-and-grant cycles of one pair, every earlier record is still stored as revoked and exactly one is active; a pair with an active record is refused and nothing changes; and the storage refuses a second active record for a pair inserted past that check, leaving the first active record and the history unchanged.
open_points.question: When two administrators concurrently create an assignment or grant for the same pair with no active record, which operation results are required: must exactly one succeed and the other receive the active-duplicate refusal, may the loser receive a generic concurrency/storage failure, or are multiple outcomes explicitly permitted provided exactly one active record remains?
options: Exactly one operation succeeds and the other receives the specified active-record refusal
Exactly one succeeds, but the loser may receive a concurrency or storage failure
Any linearizable outcome is permitted, including both operations failing, provided at most one active record exists
open_points.default_guess: Require exactly one success and one active-record refusal, with one newly active record and all revoked history unchanged.

witness.initial: All records for one (viewer_id, project_id) pair are revoked and the Registry project is active.
events: Administrator A calls grant_viewer_project for the pair.
Administrator B concurrently calls grant_viewer_project for the same pair before either call completes.
outcomes: One call succeeds and the other is refused as an active duplicate; exactly one new active grant exists.
One call succeeds while the other reports a generic storage/concurrency failure, or both fail; the persisted at-most-one-active safety property still holds.
witness.observer: The two administrator callers see different required operation outcomes.

open_points.subject: A3 INV-009 Required tests
open_points.text: after several revoke-and-grant cycles of one pair, every earlier record is still stored as revoked and exactly one is active
open_points.question: How many revoke-and-grant cycles must the required test perform to satisfy “several,” and must this history test be shown independently for staff assignments, viewer grants, and producer grants?
options: At least two complete revoke-and-grant cycles for each of the three pair types
At least three complete cycles for each pair type
One representative pair type is tested through multiple cycles while the other types receive only single-cycle tests
open_points.default_guess: Use at least two complete cycles for each of the three pair types.

open_points.subject: A31 security-review invariant
open_points.question: What must this Required tests item show about the security review, including the changed concurrency row: merely that the lint command exits successfully, or that every category has an allowed outcome and every APPLICABLE reference resolves to an accepted decision covering each named affected concern?
options: Assert every category has an allowed outcome and every APPLICABLE reference resolves to an accepted decision covering its affected concern
Assert only that the lint command exits successfully
Assert classification and reference existence, but not that the referenced decisions cover the affected concerns
open_points.default_guess: Require the check to demonstrate the invariant explicitly: complete category classification plus valid, substantively applicable accepted-decision resolution for every APPLICABLE category.
